expert-model.title: Models and run allowances
expert-model.intro: Choose once per role, with optional task overrides. This only reads current tool options and never calls a model.
expert-model.individual_help: Choose a separate model and execution settings for a checked task. Uncheck to use the role selection.
expert-model.budget_help: Native tasks reserve and settle their own allowances. Codex tasks observe usage and may send notices; they do not provide hard allowances or exact prices. Dependency waits use no execution slot.
